package fixture

// The near miss: an environment IS set, but it is the caller's own, so GOFLAGS
// travels into the child exactly as before. Only goenv.Clean counts, and a
// command that is not a go command (git here) is nobody's business of this
// rule.

import (
	"os"
	"os/exec"
)

func buildTool(dir, out string) error {
	cmd := exec.Command("go", "build", "-o", out, dir)
	cmd.Env = append(os.Environ(), "CGO_ENABLED=0")
	return cmd.Run()
}

func describe(dir string) ([]byte, error) {
	cmd := exec.Command("git", "-C", dir, "describe", "--tags")
	cmd.Env = os.Environ()
	return cmd.Output()
}
